messages:
Priya: Quick kickoff for BrightPath onboarding — want to get alignment on stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30-day ship plan. High level: customer wants a production-ready inference path + enablement.

Priya: Stakeholders I have: Alicia (CS ops lead), Marco (AE), Tom (SE), Devon (Onboard Eng). Customer contacts: jen@brightpath.com (PM), sam@brightpath.com (infra).

Priya: Success criteria (proposed):
- API keys and service account provisioned + secrets in Vault
- Staging pool with representative traffic and perf baseline (p95 < target)
- Runbook + rollback playbook in GH + recorded enablement session
- Acceptance sign-off by customer PM (integration tests passing)

Priya: Timeline sketch (30-day):
W0 (days 0–3): access, service accounts, staging pool provisioned
W1 (days 4–10): sample traffic, perf baseline, initial tuning
W2 (days 11–17): batching/quant profiles, quantization trials if needed
W3 (days 18–24): final QA, dry run, enablement recording
W4 (days 25–30): go-live + 7-day watch

Priya: Asks: @Tom — confirm staging capacity and any model constraints. @Devon — can you provision staging pool and share firewall CIDR requirement? @Alicia — own CSM acceptance checklist and recording. Marco — any contract/renewal redflags to surface?

Tom: Confirming — we can allocate a 1-GPU staging pool to start. Need expected QPS and model size to finalize memory / kv cache sizing. Also: do they plan streaming?

Priya: They expect ~1–2 qps steady, 8–12 qps bursts; model is ~7B opt-quant variant, streaming not required initially.

Devon: On it. I'll spin up a staging pool tomorrow AM. Need the service account email + a CIDR block to whitelist. Will use Vault for secrets.

Devon: Quick onboarding snippet I usually drop in the ticket:
```
# staging provisioning (example)
./provision-staging --pool-size 1 --type gpu-a10x --model redwood/7b-opt-quant 
# request: attach service account 'brightpath-onboard@redwood-prod' and allow CIDR 34.120.0.0/16
```

Devon: I'll also create GH issue and link infra ticket.

infra-bot: Provisioning request created: #req-8891. Status: pending approvals (owner: platform-approvals). ETA: 24h once approved.

Marco: Noted re: renewal risk — customer flagged data residency and audit controls during sales. If residency becomes a blocker we should propose a Private pilot in week 1 as a decision point. I'll draft the optional addendum.

Alicia: I'll capture the acceptance checklist and schedule enablement invites. Requesting names/emails for two L2 engineers from the customer to add to the runbook. I'll also ask for sample payloads and peak qps windows.

Priya: Thanks — I'll create a JIRA board and convert this plan into tasks. Daily 9am 15-min sync next week for status (standup cadence).

Tom: LGTM. I'll post estimated mem/kv numbers by EOD. :thumbsup:

Devon: GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood/onboarding/issues/512 — added initial checklist and task owners.

Priya: Final note — acceptance criteria: 5 integration tests passing + recorded enablement video uploaded + runbook PR merged. If anything changes re: residency, mark as decision point week1. Thanks all :rocket:
